master.definition_en: A neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed of tissues that resemble dysgerminoma or seminoma and are admixed with sex cord tissues. It is found in children or young adults and usually is associated with secondary sex organs abnormalities. The majority of patients present as phenotypic females with virilization. The minority of patients present as phenotypic males with feminization. It typically affects both gonads. If a malignant germ cell component is present, it may metastasize to other anatomic sites.

curated.name_zh: 慢性肾脏病与终末期肾病（尿毒症）
curated.name_en: Chronic Kidney Disease and End-Stage Renal Disease
curated.category: 器官衰竭与泌尿系统疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 肾单位不可逆进行性丢失导致eGFR逐年下降，早中期常隐匿无症状但成倍放大心脑血管死亡风险；进展至5期尿毒症期若不行规律血液透析、腹膜透析或肾移植，数周至数月内即因严重高钾血症心跳骤停、尿毒症脑病、急性左心衰肺水肿及代谢性酸中毒死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早中期（1-3期）可通过ACEI/ARB、SGLT2抑制剂、非奈利酮（“护肾新支柱”）及病因靶向治疗显著延缓进展达十余年以上甚至长期稳定；终末期肾病虽不可逆但通过血液透析、腹膜透析及肾移植可替代维持生命数十年。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算2021年全球慢性肾脏病直接导致约153万例死亡，另有大量归因于CKD伴发心血管疾病死亡

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算中国慢性肾脏病年死亡约20.4万例

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021估算全球慢性肾脏病患病人数约6.7亿至8.5亿（成人患病率约9%-10%），为增长最快的重大慢性死因之一。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 第六次全国慢性病及危险因素监测（JAMA Intern Med 2023）报告中国成人CKD患病率约为8.2%（约8,200万成人，知晓率仅约10%）；CNRDS登记显示至2023年底全国在透患者超106万例（其中血透916,647例、腹透152,745例）。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 尿毒症急性致命并发症紧急处理：合并高钾血症（血钾≥6.5 mmol/L或ECG出现QRS增宽）或急性肺水肿时，即刻静推10%葡萄糖酸钙10-20 mL稳定心肌膜电位，予胰岛素+葡萄糖及高剂量速尿/沙丁胺醇促钾内移，并紧急开通中心静脉导管行床旁血液透析或CRRT清除钾负荷与容量。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 靶向药物领域，Nefecon（IgA肾病对因治疗进入中国常规药品保障）与司美格鲁肽FLOW试验显著降低T2DM合并CKD肾脏复合终点及死亡风险；2) 异种肾移植重大里程碑：2025年FDA正式批准eGenesis和United Therapeutics开展基因编辑猪肾人体异种移植临床试验，并在多例活体受者中观察到数月至半年以上持续功能存活；中国在基因编辑供体猪研究领域亦步入临床前/探索性临床转化。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 中国成人CKD患者知晓率仅约10%，绝大多数患者直到出现尿毒症症状才首次确诊；2) 中国供肾移植年例数（约万余例）远不能满足超106万透析人群需求；3) 透析人群心血管死亡、血管钙化及难治性瘙痒依然沉重。

master.definition_en: X-linked visceral heterotaxy type 1 is a very rare form of heterotaxy that has only been reported in a few families. Heterotaxy is the right/left transposition of thoracic and/or abdominal organs. This condition is caused by mutations in the ZIC3 gene, is inherited in an X-linked recessive fashion, and is usually seen in males. Physical features include heart abnormalities such as dextrocardia, transposition of great vessels, ventricular septal defect, patent ductus arteriosus, pulmonic stenosis ; situs inversus, and missing (asplenia) and/or extra spleens (polysplenia).Affected individualscan also experience abnormalities in the development of the midline of the body, which can cause holoprosencephaly, myelomeningocele, urological anomalies, widely spaced eyes (hypertelorism), cleft palate, and abnormalities of the sacral spine and anus. Heterotaxia with recurrent respiratory infections are called primary ciliary dyskinesia.

visceral heterotaxy caused by mutation in ZIC3

Signs and symptoms associated with these cases include severe intellectual disability, distinctive facial features, normal to tall stature, gynecomastia, hypogonadism, and behavioral abnormalities. 49, XXXYY syndrome is likely caused by a mistake (called nondisjunction) that occurs at conception or during the formation of the sperm and/or egg. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person.

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

master.definition_en: Diabetic cardiomyopathy is a disorder of the heart muscle in people with diabetes. It can lead to inability of the heart to circulate blood through the body effectively, a state known as heart failure, with accumulation of fluid in the lungs (pulmonary edema) or legs (peripheral edema). Most heart failure in people with diabetes results from coronary artery disease, and diabetic cardiomyopathy is only said to exist if there is no coronary artery disease to explain the heart muscle disorder.
